name: 4-week ball plan
why: From August to October every ball number stayed flat. Your irons miss mostly off the heel (more than 1 in 3 of your 7 irons), and on the same day the hands sitting higher in the downswing go with it. Your drives start on line and curve left. For four weeks every session is judged on Square's numbers, and each practice day works on your biggest miss of the last two weeks.

steps.text: Warm up: 10 easy wedges. They don't count.
Low point day: lead foot only and step through (no ball), then 20 seven irons judged on a solid strike and 14 drives judged on the fairway.

centre.text: Centred strike day: 5 pump drill balls, then 20 seven irons judged on a centred strike (headcover outside the toe) and 14 drives judged on the fairway.

steps.text: No warm-up: the first balls of the day are the test.
Test day: 10 cold 7 irons, then 14 drives.
Then the Combine: 27 shots at 9 targets, scored against tour.
